fields.description: Marlin Icon is a canal-facing collection on Al Reem Island. Its rounded tower contains apartments, duplexes and upper-level penthouses, with retail and shared recreation facilities below.

sources.label: Marlin Icon: current developer project page
Marlin Icon: developer launch announcement, 19 October 2026
Marlin Icon: Property Finder launch guide

research.locationNote: On Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi. The embedded map’s Vista 3 caption is not adopted as the project address.
research.priceNote: Property Finder advertises AED 1.6 million at launch and AED 1,626,918 in its FAQ; Tanami quotes AED 1.63 million. These are not verified current unit offers.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 20 / 10 / 70; the table reproduces that secondary reference. Tanami also advertises monthly and 20 / 80 or 30 / 70 alternatives with differing discounts. No dated original commercial schedule was verified.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder forecasts December 2030. No contractual developer completion date or phase-specific construction percentage was verified.

facts.label: Development structure
facts.value: Cosmo Developments; fully managed and powered by Reportage Group.

facts.label: Building
facts.value: 140 residences; 3 basements, ground, 4 podium levels and 21 upper floors.

facts.label: Published mix
facts.value: 65 two-bedroom, 30 two-bedroom-plus, 35 three-bedroom, 2 three-bedroom duplex and 8 four-bedroom homes.

facts.label: Parking and retail
facts.value: 226 parking spaces and 4 retail units; individual allocations require confirmation.

facts.label: Tenure and fee reference
facts.value: Property Finder lists freehold and a 2% government fee; confirm the title and full transaction costs.
